encode_rgb_to_jpeg: encode an RGB numpy array to a JPEG byte buffer using OpenCV with quality 80
decode_jpeg_to_rgb: decode a JPEG byte buffer back into an RGB numpy array using OpenCV
compress_depth_with_blosc: compress a depth numpy array using Blosc with zstd compression and no shuffle
decompress_depth_with_blosc: decompress a Blosc-packed depth array back into a numpy array
summarize_data_compression: summarize the data_compression module functions for JPEG encoding/decoding and Blosc depth compression
